text:
clara: Quick brief  Launch + webinar in 9 days. Need a compact benchmark visual bundle and an inbound lead routing diagram for the site. Deliverables: hero banner (1200x628), social square (1080x1080), 3 microtiles (600x400), one-pager PDF template, routing SVG + CSV mapping. First comps by Tue 10am. :calendar:

zoe: Got it. Can you drop the data and preferred colors/fonts? Also confirm headline length and CTAs.

clara: Data: https://files.redwood/launch/brief_v2.csv. Use latency on x, cost on y. Mini sparkline inset for per-token cost. Colors: Primary Blue #0A6AFF (latency), Accent Coral #FF6B61 (cost). Fonts: Inter (body), Inter-Bold (h1). Headline: Variant A <=6 words, Variant B up to 10 words. CTAs: "Try Hosted API", "Book Dedicated Demo", "Download one-pager".

max: For routing, we need tags: source, plan, intent. Routing rules: hosted -> marketing-nurture, dedicated -> sales-queue (immediate notify), private -> partner-engage. Include CSV mapping example and a mock webhook payload (no keys).

clara: CSV mapping example to include in ticket:
```
form_field,webhook_key
utm_source,source
plan_choice,plan
interest_area,intent
```
Also call out enterprise flow on diagram and CRM create for sales.

zoe: Design notes: mobile-first, provide light/dark logo variants, maintain 24px clearspace. Microtiles: short insight (1 line) + bold metric. Run AA contrast check; provide alt text for each asset. Motion: small sparkline draw only (<7s). Provide static PNG fallbacks.

legal: Quick flag: if you mention third-party model names or % improvements, add attribution and cite sources. We'll review once comps are uploaded.

design-bot: Ticket created: DESIGN-9001 "Launch micro-bench kit + routing diagram"  assignee: zoe, due: 2841604800.

zoe: I'll assemble 2 hero variants, microtiles, PDF template, routing SVG, and export-ready Figma with tagged slices. Deliver PNGs + figma link by Tue 10am. Pinging here when uploaded. :white_check_mark:

clara: Awesome, thanks! If anything blocks, ping me in-thread or DM. :pray:
